desc: Newspaper publication(s) for intimation to convene 31st AGM of the Company through VC/OAVM
Notice of the 31st AGM of the Company for the Financial Year 2025 - 26
Letter to Shareholders providing web-link for accessing the Annual Report for the Financial Year 2025 - 26
Newspaper publication intimating that the 31st AGM of the Company is scheduled to be held on September 18, 2026 through VC/OAVM

Sikozy Realtors Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 03/09/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve 1.34th Annual Report of the Company for the financial year 2025-26. 

2.To discuss any other matter with the permission of Chairman.
